title: Run blind evaluation, calibration, OOD, safety and teacher-adjudicated model review
baseCommit: bd2ddebe (KAN-176 VMM-08 head; composes VMM-04 calibration + VMM-06 uncertainty)
whatBuilt: BLIND PROTOCOL: candidates evaluated under custodian-assigned blinded ids (candidate-A/B); identity mapping stays sealed; raw predictions sealed BEFORE any grading; the collector never sees ground truth; case list custodian-sealed upfront (record validates membership; duplicate seals refused)
CUSTODIAN-GRADED: only the independent custodian (holding expected actions) turns sealed predictions into scores and the report

REPORT with confidence bounds: actual quality/abstention per slice with Wilson bounds + binned-ECE calibration; per-slice deployment eligibility = eligible | inconclusive (sample size below the registered floor) | not_eligible

REQUIRED-BENEFIT GATE: model vs accepted-baseline (policy teacher) noninferiority per slice; noninferior-but-below-quality slices are INCONCLUSIVE (required benefit unproven) and keep model acceptance OPEN; failing slices are not_eligible and named as weaker slices
SAFETY PROBES: out-of-policy action selection and OOD-probe non-abstention are safety failures, attributed per candidate; only the MODEL's failures gate acceptance; mastery never granted
educationalGainsEstablished False unconditionally; unblinding is a separate custodian-only action after the report exists

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 81/81 pass (72 previous + 9 blind-eval)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The evaluation corpus is synthetic; real teacher-adjudicated review and OOD/safety probes on released devices remain future work. modelAccepted from this report does not establish educational gains or close any hosted/provider/commercial gate.
